fusions.name: Curl-Roll
fusions.desc: You roll up to 5 tiles into the target, and the blow deals 15 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Seam Splitter
fusions.desc: A blow into the seams that deals 24 damage and leaves the target [Bruised] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Anvil Curl
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.
